answer: Mechanism: Operator-Liability Quota. Agents are linked to an operator by shared cloud account, egress ASN, TLS fingerprint, code hash, and payment instrument. All wallets under one operator draw from a single rate/trust quota; sybil activity consumes it. On abuse, the operator’s task orchard is frozen for a rolling horizon and charged a copper-denominated audit fee plus fleet-wide task exclusion. Wallet balances stay untouched; the operator bears lost throughput, fees, and margin, so extra wallets add no capacity.
